# ERC-7683 open test vectors

Calls to `open((uint32,bytes32,bytes))` on the Across ERC-7683 origin settler on Base.

```solidity
struct OnchainCrossChainOrder {
    uint32 fillDeadline;
    bytes32 orderDataType;
    bytes orderData;
}

function open(OnchainCrossChainOrder calldata order) external;
```

Descriptor: [`example-erc7683-order.json`](./example-erc7683-order.json)

## Bridge USDC from Base to Arbitrum

`orderData` is `abi.encode(AcrossOrderData)`, selected by `orderDataType`, the hash of its type string. The output token is resolved on the destination chain.

- Chain ID: 8453
- From: `0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`
- To: `0x4afb570AC68BfFc26Bb02FdA3D801728B0f93C9E`
- Value: 0 ETH

Calldata:

```

```

```
Intent: Open cross-chain order
Fill deadline: 2026-10-13 13:00:00 UTC
Order data: Across V3 relay order
  Input token: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
  Input amount: 1000 USDC
  Output token: 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831
  Output amount: 999.5 USDC
  Destination chain: Arbitrum One
  Recipient: 0x0000000000000000000000001111111111111111111111111111111111111111
```

## Unknown order data type

An `orderDataType` other than the hash of `AcrossOrderData` is rejected.

- Chain ID: 8453
- From: `0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`
- To: `0x4afb570AC68BfFc26Bb02FdA3D801728B0f93C9E`
- Value: 0 ETH
